title: CPCBuild project
description: cpcbuild.json: marks a CPC Game Studio project and lists its build targets.

library.description: Path to the cpcbuild checkout (the folder with tools/), relative to this file. Needed only for cpcbuild.assets.engine "python". The BASIC library itself is the one inside the extension. null = use the cpcbuild.library.path setting or search upwards.

assets.description: Glob patterns of Studio asset documents.

id.description: Unique target id; also the output file name in build/.

arch.description: Only "cpc": the Spectrum targets were removed in CPCBuild 0.2.0.

main.description: The .bas file to compile, relative to this file.

defines.description: -D NAME or NAME=VALUE. The model macros (CPC464, CPC6128, PLUS) are named by the target itself.

ownFont.description: Adds -D CPC_OWNFONT (a cartridge has no firmware font).

heap.description: Heap size in bytes (--heap). Absent: the compiler's default.

package.description: dsk: AMSDOS disc. cpr: Plus cartridge (needs bare and ownFont). bin: raw output.

disc.description: AMSDOS name of the program on the disc: 1-8 characters A-Z 0-9 (run"NAME). Derived from the target id when absent.
